questions.prompt: Which of the following tasks is NOT a part of hierarchical design implementation methodologies:
Which of the following statements does NOT describe the advantages of hierarchical design implementation methodologies compared to flat design implementation methodologies for physical design:
options: The physical implementation tools need to handle smaller problems for various blocks.
Different teams can concurrently implement multiple blocks.
Overall design time can reduce due to the parallel implementation of blocks.
The final figures of merit can suffer in hierarchical design implementation.
questions.accepted: The final figures of merit can suffer in hierarchical design implementation.

questions.prompt: Which of the following functions is typically NOT provided by an I/O cell in an integrated circuit:
The advantage of creating standard cell rows oriented in alternating 180-degree rotation is:
options: It allows us to obtain the correct logical functionality.
It allows us to share the power and ground lines for adjacent rows.
It removes glitches in the circuit induced by signal integrity issues.
It eases the task of clock gating and power gating to save switching power dissipation.
questions.accepted: It allows us to share the power and ground lines for adjacent rows.

questions.prompt: The IR drop in the power lines can be reduced typically by
options: Increasing the resistance of the power supply lines.
Using the higher levels of metal layers.
Decreasing the width of the power supply lines.
Using lower levels of metal layers.
questions.accepted: Using the higher levels of metal layers.

questions.prompt: The phenomenon of transport of metal mass in the direction opposite to current flow due to the flow of unidirectional current is known as:
A capacitor or cell inserted between the power and ground lines to mitigate the problem of IR drop hotspots is known as
Why do we need to carry out legalization after global placement during standard cell placement?
options: To avoid legal proceedings against designer
To remove overlap among standard cells
To make incremental changes in the functionality
questions.accepted: To remove overlap among standard cells
